name: Inori ni wa Toui Hikari no Boku-tachi
original_name: いのりには遠い光のぼくたち
source:
The mysterious tale of a young named "Uro", who was sealed away for a long time, and the girl named "Kuzu" who broke his seal.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13424]Novelgame[/url]]
